title: Intelligent TnT Efficient Blast Chamber
description:
It's exactly a year since I posted my first decent video about the maximum efficiency blast chamber. To celebrate I decided to dive back into the world of blast chambers and develop a brand new, intelligent blast chamber with simple self diagnostics allowing it to detect when something is wrong, shut down then alert the player.
